published_implementation.historical_relation: The source executes published harness binaries through harness-specific native protocol/configuration adapters against one local scripted mock workload. Exact source versions are published for the six admitted arms, but W1 does not adjudicate canonical historical linkage.

benchmark.name: Harness Perf Benchmark / codex-proxy-fix deterministic mock workload
task_set: source-defined 100-round scripted tool-use workload with protocol-specific adapter script

result.representative_sample: median end-to-end duration among three serial runs

execution.environment: macOS on Apple Silicon, 18 logical cores; source batch load average approximately 2.9-3.8
execution.model: local scripted mock only; no real model inference
execution.workload: 100 tool-use rounds; the source uses a pi-specific 133-entry script to exercise the source-defined 100-round workload
execution.evaluator: resource sampler and publisher CU calculation; no task-correctness evaluator
execution.reset_policy: new harness process per serial sample in the source playground sandbox; cache warmth, JIT state, and background-service reset are not published as controlled dimensions

unknown_dimensions: exact macOS version and Apple Silicon model beyond the published 18-core description
cache warmth and JIT state for each serial sample
background process state beyond the published batch load range
observations.notes: CU is the publisher's Beta metric: integrated process-tree CPU plus memory with project-defined 1:1 weighting. This observation records resource overhead only and does not encode capability or task quality.
